title: August and the Current
author: Wren Thornbury
blurb: Petra Voss, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
